cypher:
MATCH (u1:User {user_id: 1})-[:FOLLOWS*1..2]-(u2:User),
              (u2)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:Post),
              (u2)<-[:LIKED]-(like:Post)
        RETURN u2.user_id AS userId,
               COUNT(DISTINCT p) AS postCount,
               COUNT(DISTINCT like) AS likeCount
        ORDER BY postCount DESC
        LIMIT 5
